name: vt-unknown-cmd

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: The receiver rule for an unknown command (C4 decision 3): a kind-1 object whose command the worker does not know is answered with error unknown_cmd and the connection is kept — the worker neither drops the socket nor treats the message as bad_request. After hello and hello_ack the core sends a command this tag does not define; the VT answers unknown_cmd and a later valid command on the same socket is still served. The unknown command is marked `unknown`, so self-check proves the name is genuinely not in vt-ipc. Graded by the U4 worker (owed) and the U2 core (owed).
